name: pp1a replicase polyprotein
note: 4060 aa GAV / 4070-4076 aa YHV; carries 3CLpro, PLP1, PLPx and HD1-HD4.

name: pp1ab replicase polyprotein
note: 6673-6692 aa, from a -1 ribosomal frameshift at 23-25% efficiency.

name: p20 nucleocapsid
note: 144 aa GAV / 146 aa YHV, ORF2, upstream of the glycoprotein gene -- unique among nidoviruses.

name: pp3 glycoprotein precursor
note: 1640-1666 aa, from subgenomic mRNA 3, cleaved into p25 + gp116 + gp64.

name: gp116 envelope glycoprotein
note: 845-899 aa. Deposits exist but are 267-338 aa FRAGMENTS, so the real product is derived by cutting pp3 at its measured [Ala-X-Ala] site rather than binned.

name: gp64 envelope glycoprotein
note: 538-539 aa. Same: the deposits are fragments; the product is derived.

name: p25 triple membrane-spanning protein
note: 228 aa, the N-terminal pp3 product. ABSENT from the database: no deposit anywhere. Derived from pp3. NOTE the source disagreement -- the ICTV profile calls it p25 and the Walker & Sittidilokratna review calls it p22 at 228 aa; 228 aa is about 25 kDa, so p25 is used.

name: px / ORFX
note: 86 aa, alternative frame overlapping the 5' end of ORF3. ABSENT from the database: zero deposits. Extracted from the genomes; all 15 extractions exactly 86 aa.

name: ORF4
note: 83 aa, GAV only; truncated after 20 codons in YHV.

name: nsp mature peptides of pp1ab
note: DELIBERATELY NOT DECLARED. The ICTV profile states the number and composition of the nsps released from pp1ab is not yet known. Deposits annotated 3C-like protease, helicase and RNA polymerase exist but are domain fragments with no published junctions; only the 3CLpro SPECIFICITY VxHE|(L/V) is characterised, and a specificity is not a coordinate.

name: membrane (M) protein
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. Roniviruses have no discrete M gene; p25 is the protein that resembles a coronavirus M.
